description: Popular Islamic Modaraba is a multipurpose, perpetual Modaraba established in 1994 under the Modaraba Ordinance of 1980, managed by Popular Islamic Modaraba Management Company (Private) Limited. It was acquired in 2013 by the Popular Group of Industries. It is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, is a member of the NBFI and Modaraba Association of Pakistan, and provides Shariah-compliant financing facilities.
